preverification_events.description: A person in mid-air (likely airborne due to being thrown or jumping) collides with or is struck by another individual near a market stall; the dynamic pose suggests physical combat initiation.
Two individuals are engaged in close physical struggle inside a doorway; one appears to be pushing or grappling the other, consistent with mutual combat.
A person is seen climbing over a wall while being physically restrained or pulled back by another individual behind them, indicating active resistance and physical conflict.

A man in a black shirt and cap raises a handgun with his right hand and appears to fire it; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the posture and weapon orientation strongly indicate an active shooting motion.
A man with a backpack physically engages another man on stone steps: he grabs or shoves him (f11), then appears to lift or throw him (f12–f13), indicating mutual or one-sided physical combat.
A hand holds a black semi-automatic pistol pointed forward against a concrete wall; the gun is clearly visible and aimed, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
The man with the backpack appears to be engaged in a physical struggle or being grabbed from behind by another person near the railing; motion blur and body positioning suggest close-contact combat.

rejected.reason: In f3–f5 (11.5–12.5), the man climbs over sacks and leaps off a ledge down a vine-covered wall—no second person is visible, no physical contact occurs; this is solo movement/escape, not Fighting.
In f7–f8 (13.5–14.0), two individuals enter the stall area; one walks past produce while the other follows—no aggression, resistance, or physical interaction is visible; not Fighting.
In f10–f11 (15.0–15.5), a man moves along a wall and ascends stairs alone; no opponent or interaction is present; not Fighting.

In f13 (16.5 s), a man holds a handgun raised near his head, but no muzzle flash, recoil, or bullet impact is visible; per definition, 'Shooting requires visible shooting', and aiming alone does not satisfy this—only possession is shown, not shooting.
No mutual physical combat is visible; the man with the backpack runs up stairs while a shirtless man stands passively at the top, and later steps aside—no contact or aggression occurs.
Frames f4 and f5 show a hand holding a pistol pointed at a wall, but no muzzle flash, recoil, or impact is visible; thus no shooting is confirmed.

Frames f6–f7 show a person with a backpack ducking or moving quickly down stairs, possibly reacting to something off-screen, but no second person, contact, or aggression is visible—no fighting occurs.
